name: Devendra K Mishra

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Devendra K Mishra writes poetry and fiction. His books include The Cursed Crow, Whenever I Feel and The Cara Coffee Bar. The latter follows university memories, friendship and an unexplained absence, while his poems also appear in literary spaces such as Primelore.

“Beaming Sorrows” condenses its landscape into brief, strongly sounded lines. Sun, river, wind, woods and birds take on the gestures of a troubled inner world. The quick movement of its images holds heat, weariness and grief together, ending with the unexpected suggestion that sorrow itself can shine.
